name: Semantix, Inc.
summary: Established in São Paulo, Brazil, in 2010, Semantix, Inc. and its affiliated companies deliver a comprehensive suite of data solutions across Latin America and the United States. At the core of their offerings is SDP, a proprietary, multi-cloud Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) data platform. This platform empowers organizations with essential capabilities such as data integration, operational management, machine learning operations, robust data governance, secure data sharing, and intuitive data visualization. It is primarily adopted by entities in the financial services sector, healthcare providers (including operators of health plans, brokers, hospitals, clinics, and diagnostic facilities), and various retailers. Beyond its flagship platform, Semantix also acts as a reseller for third-party software, catering to diverse industries like finance, retail, telecommunications, healthcare, and manufacturing. The company further extends its expertise through a range of artificial intelligence and data analytics services. These services encompass strategic consulting, cloud infrastructure monitoring, intricate data integration, advanced data science initiatives, and specialized data engineering.
